vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 60s, the person in their 40s, Utpal, Xavier and Sigrun met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 driven off. the person in their 60s, the person in their 40s, Utpal, Xavier, Sigrun are hurt.
🛡️ Anh, Elijah, Henry, Tariq and Maya met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Anh, Elijah, Tariq are hurt.
🛡️ Elijah, Henry, Utpal, Xavier and Sigrun met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Elijah, Utpal, Xavier, Sigrun are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Anh just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xavier just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xavier just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Elijah, Henry, Utpal, Ulzhan and Xavier met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Utpal, Ulzhan, Xavier are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
(Prolongs fights — avoids killing blows, aims to wound. Each wound teaches it (slight accuracy increase per wound inflicted). Killing it quickly denies it data (it respects efficiency).)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ayan just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ayan just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lily just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kambale and Lily met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Kambale is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lily just put down The Network Note... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lily just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lily met them at the door — 1 put down. Lily is hurt.
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Lily taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Lily showed Tariq the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Lily drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
